source_text: In the UK context, National Health Service (NHS) data from the FGM Enhanced Dataset, covering over 25,000 identified cases since 2015, reveal frequent presentations for complications such as recurrent infections (affecting 20-30% of cases) and deinfibulation surgeries, underscoring lifelong morbidity that drives annual treatment costs exceeding £20 million. [62]
